text: You see a weary traveler.

text: You see Lance, one of the guards from Shady Sands' long-range patrols.
source_text: You see Lance, one of the guards from Shady Sands' long-range patrols.

text: Just stay where you are. We've heard about you in Shady Sands and we want no part of you.

Just stay where you are. We've heard about you in Shady Sands and

text: The only part of you that I want is what you're carrying. Strip down.
source_text: The only part of you that I want is what you're carrying. Strip down.

text: I'm a man of peace, friend.
source_text: I'm a man of peace, friend.

text: Hey, didn't I save Tandi and kill off all your radscorpions?
source_text: Hey, didn't I save Tandi and kill off all your radscorpions?

text: I have no quarrel with Shady Sands. I kinda like the place.
source_text: I have no quarrel with Shady Sands. I kinda like the place.

text: Herung?
source_text: Herung?

text: I heard about you, and I ain't letting you kill me.
source_text: I heard about you, and I ain't letting you kill me.

text: I don't have anything to say to you.
source_text: I don't have anything to say to you.

text: Yeah? What d'ya want this time?
source_text: Yeah? What d'ya want this time?

text: Would you know where I could find a water chip?
source_text: Would you know where I could find a water chip?

text: Any sign of Tandi?
source_text: Any sign of Tandi?

text: Any problems with raiders lately?
source_text: Any problems with raiders lately?

text: How are things in Shady Sands?
source_text: How are things in Shady Sands?

text: Hnng!
source_text: Hnng!

text: Hello, stranger. What brings you out in the wastes? Where are you from?
source_text: Hello, stranger. What brings you out in the wastes? Where are you from?

text: I could ask the same thing about you.
source_text: I could ask the same thing about you.

text: Sorry friend, but I get the impression that's a rather dangerous question to answer.
source_text:
Sorry friend, but I get the impression that's a rather dangerous
 question to answer.

text: Know any place good to get supplies?
source_text: Know any place good to get supplies?

text: I'm from a Vault. Lucky Vault 13!
source_text: I'm from a Vault. Lucky Vault 13!

text: Waaah?
source_text: Waaah?

text: Hello, stranger. I'd recommend that you keep on moving, if you know what's good for you.
source_text:
Hello, stranger. I'd recommend that you keep on moving, if you
 know what's good for you.

text: Hello,
source_text: Hello,

text: . I thought you were our friend when you rescued Tandi, but now I hear some real nasty rumors about you. Are they true?
source_text:
. I thought you were our friend when you rescued Tandi, but now I hear
 some real nasty rumors about you. Are they true?

text: People say all sorts of things. Who cares?
source_text: People say all sorts of things. Who cares?

text: I ain't your friend. And if you make a wrong move, I'll spill your innards. You got that?
source_text:
I ain't your friend. And if you make a wrong move, I'll spill your
 innards. You got that?

text: What kind of rumors?
source_text: What kind of rumors?

text: Yeah. They're all true. Now strip down so I can take what you've got.
source_text: Yeah. They're all true. Now strip down so I can take what you've got.

text: Maybe I've done a few things I regret, but you should know better than believing that crap.
source_text:
Maybe I've done a few things I regret, but you should know better than
 believing that crap.

text: . Am I glad it's you and not some raider! How's it going! I'm Lance, one of the guards over in Shady Sands. Sorry we gave you such a hard time when you first came to town!
source_text:
. Am I glad it's you and not some raider! How's it going! I'm Lance, one
 of the guards over in Shady Sands. Sorry we gave you such a hard time when

text: Hi Lance, what's up?
source_text: Hi Lance, what's up?

text: Hi Lance. I used to be a nice person, but then life screwed me. Now strip down and hand over your stuff.
source_text:
Hi Lance. I used to be a nice person, but then life screwed me. Now strip
 down and hand over your stuff.

text: Don't sweat it, Lance. What are you doing out here alone?
source_text: Don't sweat it, Lance. What are you doing out here alone?

text: Fine. But I'll remember this.
source_text: Fine. But I'll remember this.

text: Up yours.
source_text: Up yours.

text: Spare me the idle threats, boy. I kill children like you in my sleep. Hand over your belongings, and I may let you live.
source_text:
Spare me the idle threats, boy. I kill children like you in my sleep.
 Hand over your belongings, and I may let you live.

text: If you really think I'm a threat, go ahead and kill me.
source_text: If you really think I'm a threat, go ahead and kill me.

text: Let's make a wrong move. I always wanted to see what my innards look like.
source_text: Let's make a wrong move. I always wanted to see what my innards look like.

text: That was then, this is now. What have you done for us lately? I think you better leave before I get ornery.
source_text:
That was then, this is now. What have you done for us lately? I
 think you better leave before I get ornery.

text: We like it too. Especially when you're not in it. Now get!
source_text: We like it too. Especially when you're not in it. Now get!

text: Man, you musta spent too much time in the Glow!
source_text: Man, you musta spent too much time in the Glow!

text: I don't know what a water chip is. Sorry.
source_text: I don't know what a water chip is. Sorry.

text: It's an electronic device used in water purification systems.
source_text: It's an electronic device used in water purification systems.

text: How's the radscorpion problem?
source_text: How's the radscorpion problem?

text: The raiders got her. I'm part of one of the search parties. I think she's at the raider camp south of Shady Sands, but the Khans have the place sealed up like a fortress.
source_text:
The raiders got her. I'm part of one of the search parties. I think she's
 at the raider camp south of Shady Sands, but the Khans have the place sealed up
 like a fortress.

text: Can you take me to Shady Sands?
source_text: Can you take me to Shady Sands?

text: Can you take me to the Khans?
source_text: Can you take me to the Khans?

text: We'll have to find a way to get her back.
source_text: We'll have to find a way to get her back.

text: Thanks for the information. Good luck with the search.
source_text: Thanks for the information. Good luck with the search.

text: Uh, yeah, but we're handling it a little better since the Khans got their bloody nose. I understand we have you to thank for that. We're grateful.
source_text:
Uh, yeah, but we're handling it a little better since the Khans got their
 bloody nose. I understand we have you to thank for that. We're grateful.

text: I wouldn't mind seeing a little gratitude.
source_text: I wouldn't mind seeing a little gratitude.

text: Thanks. Anything else I can do?
source_text: Thanks. Anything else I can do?

text: Let me know if they bother you again.
source_text: Let me know if they bother you again.

text: We're doing okay.
source_text: We're doing okay.

text: Are you sure about that?
source_text: Are you sure about that?

text: That's great.
source_text: That's great.

text: I haven't a clue. Idiot.
source_text: I haven't a clue. Idiot.

text: Okay, I'll trust you. I'm from Shady Sands. We're a community not far from here.
source_text:
Okay, I'll trust you. I'm from Shady Sands. We're a community not far from
 here.

text: Could you take me there?
source_text: Could you take me there?

text: What's the town like?
source_text: What's the town like?

text: Any water chips there?
source_text: Any water chips there?

text: Sounds like a nice place.
source_text: Sounds like a nice place.

text: Well, you keep your secrets, I'll keep mine. Good bye.
source_text: Well, you keep your secrets, I'll keep mine. Good bye.

text: Maybe it is. A pity, though.
source_text: Maybe it is. A pity, though.

text: I've been to Junktown. I think it's southwest of here, but I've been traveling for so many days it's hard to tell.
source_text:
I've been to Junktown. I think it's southwest of here, but I've been
 traveling for so many days it's hard to tell.

text: Yeah, right. All the Vaults were destroyed, as far as I know. Tell me another one.
source_text:
Yeah, right. All the Vaults were destroyed, as far as I know. Tell me
 another one.

text: That's not what I was asking . . . oh, never mind!
source_text: That's not what I was asking . . . oh, never mind!

text: That's not an answer. They call you assassin, thief, grave-robber. They say you'll kill anyone who gets in your path. Is it true?
source_text:
That's not an answer. They call you assassin, thief, grave-robber. They
 say you'll kill anyone who gets in your path. Is it true?

text: Well, I haven't killed you yet, so obviously someone's lying.
source_text: Well, I haven't killed you yet, so obviously someone's lying.

text: Pretty much. I've had my share of good times.
source_text: Pretty much. I've had my share of good times.

text: I've made my share of enemies. I've left enough of them alive to slander me.
source_text:
I've made my share of enemies. I've left enough of them alive to slander
 me.

text: I've killed quite a few people, yeah. I always had a reason.
source_text: I've killed quite a few people, yeah. I always had a reason.

text: They call you assassin, thief, grave-robber. They say you'll kill anyone who gets in your path. Is it true?
source_text:
They call you assassin, thief, grave-robber. They say you'll kill anyone
 who gets in your path. Is it true?

text: Okay, I'll do it. But if you keep acting like a raider, you'll die like a raider.
source_text:
Okay, I'll do it. But if you keep acting like a raider, you'll die like
 a raider.

text: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt, for now. But a man's only as good as his reputation, and yours could use some work. I hope you'll do something about it before we meet again.
source_text:
I'll give you the benefit of the doubt, for now. But a man's only as good
 as his reputation, and yours could use some work. I hope you'll do something
 about it before we meet again.

text: Just heading back to town. You wanna come along? I could use the company.
source_text: Just heading back to town. You wanna come along? I could use the company.

text: Sure.
source_text: Sure.

text: Not today.
source_text: Not today.

text: A little bit of scavenging. We've found a few abandoned raider bases that haven't been picked clean; I suspect they've been attacking each other. We can always use more ammo and chems.
source_text:
A little bit of scavenging. We've found a few abandoned raider bases that
 haven't been picked clean; I suspect they've been attacking each other. We can
 always use more ammo and chems.

text: I'm going to regret this.
source_text: I'm going to regret this.

text: Get out of my sight before I come to my senses.
source_text: Get out of my sight before I come to my senses.

text: We're still seeing a few; they must be migrating from the high desert or the Glow. But it's a lot better now than it was last year, thanks to you.
source_text:
We're still seeing a few; they must be migrating from the high desert or
 the Glow. But it's a lot better now than it was last year, thanks to you.

text: Sounds good. Bye.
source_text: Sounds good. Bye.

text: Sure. Let's go.
source_text: Sure. Let's go.

text: Man, I must be out of my mind. But I'll take you. Let's go.
source_text: Man, I must be out of my mind. But I'll take you. Let's go.

text: Have a good suicide, friend. And for what it's worth, good luck.

text: I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.
source_text: I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.

text: Well, I don't have much, but what's mine is yours.
source_text: Well, I don't have much, but what's mine is yours.

text: Not that I can think of. I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.

text: We will. I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.
source_text: We will. I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.

text: Well, okay. Let's go.
source_text: Well, okay. Let's go.

text: I won't lead a possible enemy home. If you do make your way to Shady Sands, keep your nose clean.
source_text:
I won't lead a possible enemy home. If you do make your way to Shady Sands,
 keep your nose clean.

text: Small. We make our living herding Brahmin. It's pretty rough country around here, and pasture land is rather precious.

text: In a Brahmin herding backwater? You've gotta be crazy! There's probably not a working piece of electronics within two hundred miles.

In a Brahmin herding backwater? You've gotta be crazy! There's probably
 not a working piece of electronics within two hundred miles.

text: You got a point. I think we should play things cautious and go our separate ways. If I were you, I'd do something about those stories. Unless you like people hating and mistrusting you.

text: Who are you?

text: What happened to you?
source_text: What happened to you?

text: Okay, that's cool.

text: Ru-huh?

text: The mutants overran Shady Sands. Must of use are dead. I guess it's only a matter of time before they get the rest of us.

I don't care what you say, what you ask. We're all dead! All of us! And
